task: Implement GitHub issue #10 in the static React ebook viewer: the zoom overlay opens from the '크게' button or by double-clicking a page, but on close focus always goes to the '크게' button. Remember document.activeElement when the zoom overlay is opened (in the open handlers, because the overlay's close button autofocuses on mount) and return focus to it on close; fall back to the '크게' button when it is missing, body, or no longer in the document.

context.observed_behavior: Viewer.tsx: onDoubleClick={() => setZoomed([p])} on each page; the button onClick={() => setZoomed(visible)}; an effect focuses zoomButton when zoomed goes from open to closed; the close button has autoFocus. page-flip's book mousedown handler calls preventDefault, so double-clicking a page does not move focus away from e.g. the page-number input.
context.contracts: No external API. page-flip 2.0.7 source vendored in web/node_modules (pinned in web/package-lock.json). Static site, no auth, no persisted data.
